messages.subject: about x- or y-axis
parts:
Hi ggplot2 users,

How to have superscript in x- or y-axis? For example, R2 in the x-axis. I tried various ways, but it didn't work. Thanks for your help.

+xlab(expression(paste('R^{2}')))
